articles.title: 9 people rescued after vessel capsizes in Lake Ontario
articles.summary: Nine people were rescued from Lake Ontario on Saturday afternoon after a vessel capsized near Port Credit Harbour Marina in Mississauga. The Peel Regional Police Marine Unit responded to the distress call just after 5 p.m. Officers located the overturned vessel approximately 50 metres south of the Ridgetown breakwall, with nine people clinging to it. articles.summary: A woman was pronounced dead late Saturday evening after being swept into the water at Jack Darling Park in Mississauga. articles.title: Zanzibar Tavern owner 'devastated' as Toronto Fire crews tackle fire, heavy smoke
articles.summary: The owner of a historic adult entertainment business in downtown Toronto said he's devastated after a fire broke out at the commercial building Sunday morning.

articles.title: Woman dead after falling into Lake Ontario at Mississauga park: police
articles.summary: A woman has died after falling into Lake Ontario at Jack Darling Park in Mississauga Saturday evening, Peel police said.

articles.title: Man dead after crash in Brampton: Peel police
articles.summary: A man has died after a crash in Brampton early Sunday morning, Peel police said.

articles.title: Louis Foster wins pole as racing gets underway at Ontario Honda Dealers Indy at Markham
articles.summary: Louis Foster has won pole position at the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy at Markham, Ont.

articles.title: Charles McAdoo drives in pair of runs for Blue Jays in 4-1 win over Yankees
articles.summary: Charles McAdoo drove in a pair of runs, including a go-ahead double in the seventh inning, as Toronto Blue Jays defeated the New York Yankees 4-1 at Rogers Centre on Saturday.

articles.summary: David Malukas posted the fastest practice lap at the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy at Markham.

articles.title: Man, 22, from Scarborough dead following single-vehicle crash in Pickering: OPP
articles.summary: Provincial police say a 22-year-old man is dead after a single-vehicle collision involving a motorcycle in Pickering, Ont., overnight Saturday.

articles.summary: A clinic in Toronto's east end is making it easier for new mothers to access mental health support quickly. articles.title: Mississauga man, 36, faces new charges in human trafficking investigation, police say
articles.summary: A Mississauga man accused of human trafficking is facing additional charges after two more alleged victims came forward, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Mississauga’s mayoral race is neck and neck, poll suggests
articles.summary: The race for becoming Mississauga’s next mayor is currently a coin toss between former mayor Bonnie Crombie and current mayor Carolyn Parrish, a new poll suggests.

articles.title: First practice day at Ontario Honda Dealers Indy in Markham cancelled
articles.summary: The first day of practice and qualifying at the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy at Markham has been cancelled because incomplete track.

articles.title: Stellantis is considering closing and selling Brampton assembly plant, Unifor says
articles.summary: A national union says it was told by Stellantis this week that it is seriously considering the closure and sale of the Brampton assembly plant. In a statement, Stellantis said its focus remains on finding a sustainable manufacturing solution for the plant.

articles.title: Ontario Court of Appeal says Ford can rip out Toronto bike lanes
articles.summary: Premier Doug Ford’s government can rip out 19 kilometres of protected bike lanes in Toronto, the Court of Appeal for Ontario has ruled in a decision released Friday, reversing a lower-court decision made in July 2025.
